svg.title: The rerun of a run that failed
svg.desc: An entry of the alarm names a run of GitHub Actions that failed on main, such as that of a required check, a release or an issue of the bot-health bot. Dennis presses Rerun, and the pager reads the run. While it still runs, or once it passed on a retry, the button says so and nothing starts. Otherwise its failed jobs run again, and the entry says so in the message. When they fail again, the entry shows the failure, and Rerun can run them once more. When they pass, the bot-health bot closes its issue or the release run passes, the entry goes, and the last one turns the alarm green.
